facts.subject: language
facts.text: The word 'alphabet' comes from alpha and beta, the first two letters of the Greek alphabet.

facts.subject: language
facts.text: The English alphabet has 26 letters.

facts.subject: language
facts.text: Some people read with their fingers. Braille uses raised dots that you feel.

facts.subject: language
facts.text: Rhyming words end with the same sound, like cat and hat.

facts.subject: math
facts.text: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

facts.subject: math
facts.text: A square has 4 sides that are all the same length.

facts.subject: math
facts.text: A dozen means 12.

facts.subject: math
facts.text: A honeycomb is made of tiny six-sided shapes called hexagons.

facts.subject: science
facts.text: An octopus has 3 hearts.

facts.subject: science
facts.text: Bees visit flowers to drink a sweet liquid called nectar.

facts.subject: science
facts.text: A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through raindrops.

facts.subject: science
facts.text: The Sun is a star.

facts.subject: world
facts.text: Penguins live mostly in the southern half of the world.

facts.subject: world
facts.text: There are 7 continents on Earth.

facts.subject: world
facts.text: Water covers most of the surface of the Earth.

facts.subject: world
facts.text: It takes one year for the Earth to travel all the way around the Sun.

facts.subject: health
facts.text: A grown-up has 206 bones.

facts.subject: health
facts.text: Your skin is the biggest organ of your body.

facts.subject: health
facts.text: The hard outside of your teeth is the hardest part of your body.

facts.subject: health
facts.text: Washing your hands with soap helps wash germs away.

facts.subject: digital
facts.text: The first website went online in 1991.

facts.subject: digital
facts.text: Wi-Fi sends information through the air using radio waves.

facts.subject: money

facts.text: Paper money was first used in China.

facts.subject: money
facts.text: Some of the first coins were made in a place called Lydia, a very long time ago.

facts.subject: money
facts.text: A piggy bank is a place to save coins.

facts.text: A Rubik's Cube has six faces.

facts.text: A tangram is a puzzle made of 7 flat shapes.

facts.subject: arts

facts.subject: arts

facts.subject: arts
facts.text: Origami is the art of folding paper.

facts.subject: computing
facts.text: Computers store information using only two digits: 0 and 1.

facts.text: Programmers call a mistake in a computer program a bug.

facts.subject: computing
